question: How many annual leave days do employees receive in their first two years?
expected_answer: 15 days (120 hours) per year for 0-2 years of tenure.

question: What is the annual PTO for employees with 11 or more years of tenure?
expected_answer: 30 days (240 hours) per year.

question: How many sick days do full-time employees receive per calendar year?
expected_answer: 10 sick days (80 hours) per calendar year, front-loaded on January 1.

question: How many paid holidays does Acme Corp observe in 2026?
expected_answer: 12 paid holidays per calendar year.

question: What is the minimum password length required by the information security policy?
expected_answer: Minimum length: 14 characters.

question: How often must Acme Corp passwords be changed?
expected_answer: Passwords must be changed every 90 days.

question: After how many consecutive failed login attempts is an account locked?
expected_answer: Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.

question: What is the hotel lodging cap per night for domestic travel?
expected_answer: $200 per night for domestic travel, excluding taxes and fees.

question: What is the dinner meal reimbursement limit during domestic business travel?
expected_answer: $50 per dinner for domestic travel.

question: How much does Acme Corp match on 401(k) contributions?
expected_answer: Acme Corp matches 100% of the first 4% of the employee's salary contributed.

question: How many free counseling sessions does the Employee Assistance Program provide?
expected_answer: 8 free counseling sessions per issue per year for the employee and immediate family.

question: What is the annual professional development budget per employee?
expected_answer: $2,000 per year for conferences, courses, certifications, and subscriptions.

question: What is the maximum annual tuition reimbursement amount?
expected_answer: $5,250 per calendar year, tax-free under IRS Section 127.

question: How much is the employee referral bonus?
expected_answer: $2,500, paid after the referred candidate completes 90 days of employment.

question: How many weeks of paid parental leave does Acme Corp provide?
expected_answer: 12 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% of regular base salary.

question: How many floating holidays do full-time employees receive per year?
expected_answer: 2 floating holidays per calendar year (part-time employees receive 1).

question: What is the policy ID of the Remote Work Policy?
expected_answer: ACME-HR-002.

question: Which endpoint detection and response (EDR) agent must run on company devices?
expected_answer: CrowdStrike Falcon.

question: Which company-provided password manager must all employees use?
expected_answer: 1Password Enterprise.

question: What encryption is required for Restricted data at rest?
expected_answer: AES-256 encryption at rest (and TLS 1.2 or higher in transit).

question: Which multi-factor authentication methods are approved, and which MFA method is not permitted?
expected_answer: Hardware security keys (preferred) and authenticator apps are approved; SMS-based MFA is not permitted due to SIM-swap vulnerabilities.

question: Under which medical plan can employees open a Health Savings Account?
expected_answer: The HDHP + HSA plan.

question: What is Acme Corp's dress code?
expected_answer: Business casual; use judgment based on role and client interactions.

question: Which insurance provider offers Acme Corp's medical plans?
expected_answer: Aetna (three plan options: PPO Standard, PPO Premium, HDHP + HSA).

question: Can I work from home right after being hired?
expected_answer: No. New employees must complete their 90-day onboarding period on-site before becoming eligible for hybrid or remote work.

question: Do I get money to set up my home office?
expected_answer: Fully remote employees receive a one-time $500 home office setup stipend; all remote and hybrid employees also get a monthly $75 internet and utilities stipend.

question: Am I expected to answer Slack messages right away?
expected_answer: Direct messages must be answered within 30 minutes during core hours; channel messages within 2 hours.

question: What happens to my unused vacation days at the end of the year?
expected_answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days (40 hours) carry over; anything above 5 days on December 31 is forfeited.

question: If my laptop is stolen, what should I do?
expected_answer: Report immediately to IT Security (security@acmecorp.com, extension x4700) or the 24/7 emergency hotline (555) 867-5309; a remote wipe and password reset is initiated within 1 hour.

question: Are there any paid days off for volunteering?
expected_answer: Yes - 16 hours (2 days) of paid Volunteer Time Off per calendar year.

question: Will the company pay for my professional certifications?
expected_answer: Yes - job-related certification exam registration fees, study materials, and up to 2 exam attempts per certification.

question: What happens if I fail a phishing simulation?
expected_answer: Mandatory security awareness training within 5 business days; failing 3 or more simulations in 12 months triggers a review by Security and HR.

question: If a public holiday falls during my approved vacation, do I lose a PTO day?
expected_answer: No - the holiday does not count against the employee's PTO balance.

question: Who needs to approve a $2,000 expense, and is pre-approval required?
expected_answer: Department head + VP of Finance approve $501-$2,500; pre-approval is required for all anticipated expenses over $500.

question: What pay do essential personnel receive for working on a company holiday?
expected_answer: 1.5x their regular hourly rate for all hours worked on the holiday, plus one compensatory day off to be used within 90 days.

question: How much vacation does the sample employee handbook grant employees after 11 years, and how does that compare with the Acme Corp PTO policy for the same tenure?
expected_answer: The sample handbook grants a maximum of 20 days per year from year 11 onward, while the Acme Corp PTO policy grants 30 days at 11+ years.

question: Can my manager read my work email?
expected_answer: Yes - employees have no expectation of privacy on company technology; Acme Corp reserves the right to monitor email content and metadata.
expected_source_section: 3.1 Company Resources Are Company Property / 12.1 Monitoring

question: I'm moving to a different state and will keep working remotely - what must I do?
expected_answer: Notify HR immediately about the primary remote work location change, especially across state or national borders, because payroll taxes are processed based on the documented work location.

question: What must remote employees use to connect to company systems from outside the office, per both the security and acceptable-use policies?
expected_answer: The company VPN is mandatory when accessing company resources from outside an Acme Corp office.

question: If my baby is born, how much paid leave do I get and when must I start using it?
expected_answer: 12 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% of base salary; the leave must commence within 12 months of the birth.

question: What stipend covers my home internet bill as a hybrid employee?
expected_answer: A monthly $75 internet and utilities stipend for all remote and hybrid employees.
expected_source_section: 6.2 Home Office Stipend (also referenced in expense policy 8)

question: Where do I report a suspicious or phishing email?
expected_answer: Use the Report Phishing button in Gmail or forward to phishing@acmecorp.com.

question: Does the expense reimbursement policy cover my gym membership?
expected_answer: No - gym memberships are explicitly listed as non-reimbursable expenses (though a separate $50/month wellness reimbursement exists under benefits).

question: How many bereavement days are granted for the death of a grandparent under the Acme Corp leave policy?
expected_answer: Grandparents count as immediate family, so up to 5 consecutive business days of paid bereavement leave.

question: Which tools should I use for video meetings with external parties versus internal-only meetings?
expected_answer: Zoom for meetings with external parties; Google Meet for internal-only meetings.

question: How long are company emails retained?
expected_answer: 7 years, per the Acme Corp Data Retention Schedule.

expected_answer: Broad answer expected: covers PTO accrual, sick leave, FMLA, parental leave, bereavement leave, jury duty and more.
